verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than total VRAM capacity, and independent community reports corroborate running 70B/33B models on machines with limited RAM/VRAM via split offload. missing for 10: no first-party benchmark quantifying offload performance tradeoffs, and community reports show some real-world slowdowns/swapping issues at extreme size/RAM ratios.
